full_judgment:
2. This Civil Petition for leave to appeal, at the instance of the Government of Bangladesh, has been directed against the judgment and order dated 26.01.2009 passed by the Administrative Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka in Administrative Appellate Tribunal Appeal No.16 of 2009 rejecting an application under section 6(2A) of the Administrative Tribunal Act, 1980 and consequently rejecting the appeal as barred by limitation. 

 "Because the Administrative Appellate Tribunal failed to appreciate that the reasons of delay from 11.12.2008 to 20.01.2009 i.e. the date of filing the appeal before it were clearly explained in the application where neither the authority nor the learned Penal Advocate had any negligence and thus erred in law in rejecting the appeal as barred by limitation holding that no specific reason was stated."
